tolerate noise: I can tolerate noise during the day, but the loud music next door at midnight drives me crazy.
白天我還能忍受噪音，但隔壁半夜大聲放音樂快把我逼瘋了。
tolerate differences: A good friendship requires us to respect and tolerate differences in opinions and daily habits.
良好的友誼需要我們尊重並容忍彼此在意見和生活習慣上的差異。
won't tolerate lateness: Our new English teacher won't tolerate lateness, so every student now arrives before the bell rings.
我們的新英文老師不容許遲到，所以現在每個學生都在鐘響前到校。
tolerate a drug: Some patients cannot tolerate a drug well and may feel sick or dizzy after taking it.
有些病人對藥物耐受不良，服用後可能會感到噁心或頭暈。
tolerate criticism: A good leader must learn to tolerate criticism and use it to improve the team's work.
好的領導者必須學會接受批評，並用它來改善團隊的工作。
take a toll on: Working late every night began to take a toll on his health, and he often felt tired.
每晚工作到很晚開始對他的健康造成損害，他常常覺得疲累。
take its toll: Years of stress at work can take its toll, so experts suggest taking regular breaks to relax.
多年的工作壓力會造成損失，所以專家建議定期休息放鬆。
the death toll: The death toll from the earthquake rose to over one hundred as rescue workers searched the buildings.
隨著救難人員搜尋倒塌建築，地震的死亡人數上升到一百多人。
the bell tolls: Every evening at six, the bell tolls from the old church tower and the villagers head home.
每天傍晚六點，古老教堂鐘樓的鐘聲鳴響，村民們便動身回家。
toll roads: Drivers have to pay a fee to use toll roads, but the trip is usually much faster.
駕駛人使用收費道路必須付費，但行程通常快得多。
top the list: Bubble tea continues to top the list of the most popular drinks among Taiwanese teenagers.
珍珠奶茶持續在台灣青少年最受歡迎的飲料中高居榜首。
top off the meal: After the hot pot, we decided to top off the meal with a big bowl of mango shaved ice.
吃完火鍋後，我們決定用一大碗芒果冰為這一餐畫下句點。
top up the account: Before taking the MRT, remember to top up the account on your EasyCard at the station machine.
搭捷運前，記得在車站的機器替你的悠遊卡儲值。
top it all: I missed the bus and got caught in the rain, and to top it all, I forgot my homework.
我錯過公車又被雨淋濕，更糟的是，我還忘了帶作業。
top the record: The young swimmer hopes to top the record she set at last year's national competition.
這位年輕泳將希望打破她在去年全國賽創下的紀錄。
top a hill: It took us three hours to top a hill, but from there we could see the whole city shining below us.
我們花了三個小時才登上山頂，但從那裡可以看到整座城市在腳下閃閃發光。
torment a child: It is cruel to torment a child by constantly laughing at his mistakes in front of others.
在別人面前不斷嘲笑孩子的錯誤來折磨小孩是很殘忍的。
be tormented by guilt: After lying to his best friend, Tom was tormented by guilt and felt painful regret for days.
對最好的朋友說謊之後，湯姆受罪惡感折磨，好幾天都痛苦地懊悔不已。
torment oneself: Stop tormenting yourself over one bad test score; you can still do well on the final exam.
別再為了一次考差的成績自我折磨了，你期末考還是可以考得很好。
a tormented soul: The main character in the novel is a tormented soul who cannot forget the painful war he survived.
這本小說的主角是個飽受折磨的靈魂，無法忘記他倖存下來的那場痛苦戰爭。
torture oneself with doubts: Instead of torturing yourself with doubts, just ask her directly whether she is still angry with you.
與其因疑慮而自我折磨，不如直接問她是否還在生你的氣。
torture a prisoner: International law clearly says that it is wrong to torture a prisoner to get information.
國際法明確規定，為了取得情報而刑求囚犯是錯誤的。
it's torture to wait: The test results come out next week, and it's torture to wait without knowing whether I passed.
考試結果下週才公布，在不知道自己是否及格的情況下等待真是種煎熬。
torture the truth: Some news reports torture the truth by leaving out important facts to make stories more exciting.
有些新聞報導刻意省略重要事實來扭曲事實，好讓故事更刺激。
toss a coin: We couldn't decide who should go first, so we tossed a coin to make the choice fair.
我們無法決定誰先開始，所以擲硬幣讓選擇公平一點。
toss and turn: I was so nervous about the exam that I tossed and turned all night and barely slept.
我對考試太緊張了，整晚輾轉難眠，幾乎沒睡。
toss out an idea: During the class meeting, Amy tossed out an idea about holding a charity sale at school.
在班會上，艾咪隨口提出在學校舉辦義賣的想法。
toss aside: Don't toss aside your old textbooks, because younger students might find them useful.
別把你的舊課本隨手拋開，因為學弟妹可能會覺得很有用。
toss a salad: While Mom grilled the chicken, I helped toss a salad with lettuce, tomatoes, and dressing.
媽媽烤雞的時候，我幫忙用生菜、番茄和醬汁拌沙拉。
toss away an opportunity: Don't toss away an opportunity to study abroad just because you are afraid of feeling lonely.
別只因為害怕寂寞，就白白浪費出國留學的機會。
